mapper.select: SELECT id, name, price, image_url, product_category_id, delete_flag FROM product WHERE name = #{name} AND delete_flag = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET name = #{name}, price = #{price}, product_category_id = #{productCategoryId}, image_url = #{imageUrl} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.price, p.image_url, p.product_category_id, s.quantity FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_stock s ON p.id = s.product_id WHERE p.id = #{productId}
